description: This file declares APIs for the TR-069 device IP diagnostics trace route feature, including getters and setters for trace route parameters and results, classes, methods, and documentation comments.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the DiagnosticsState parameter indicating diagnostic data status.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the source IP interface used for the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the host name or address for the route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the number of tries per hop for the trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the timeout in milliseconds per hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the size of the data block sent per trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the DSCP value used in test packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the maximum number of hops (TTL) in outgoing probes.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_ResponseTime
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the response time of the most recent trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHopsNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the number of entries in the RouteHops table.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Setter API to set the DiagnosticsState parameter, initiating trace route on 'Requested'.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Setter API to specify the source IP interface for the trace route.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Setter API to specify the host name or address to find the route.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Setter API to configure the number of tries per hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Setter API to configure the timeout per hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Setter API to set the data block size for each trace route probe.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Setter API to specify the DSCP value used in test packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Setter API to set the maximum number of hops (TTL).
